Title: Timeline
Prompt: Build a timeline with the times I wrote. Do not fill gaps with guesses. Mark gaps.

Title: Impact
Prompt: Describe who was affected using only my notes. Do not estimate a number I did not give.

Title: What we know
Prompt: Split the notes into facts and theories.

Title: Follow-up
Prompt: List follow-ups that my notes already imply. Do not assign a person I did not name.

Title: Customer note
Prompt: Draft a short note that says what failed, what we did, and what we still do not know. No blame of a named person.

Title: Next time
Prompt: Propose one change that would have made this incident easier to see. Label it a proposal.
Check: It is not written as if it already happened.
